# Provenance

- Source: project-original abstract replica model, with synthetic actors, events and deliveries.
- Fixed version: `2026-10-25-crdt-reconciliation-v0.1.2`, derived from frozen v0.1.1 by wording-only provenance cleanup; business files unchanged.
- License: project public release license pending owner decision; no external dataset or task content copied.
- Adaptation: none from external benchmarks; Harbor folder layout follows local project convention.
- Network/resources: logic remains offline. The user explicitly authorized network for the formal new62 task and free trial copy; `allow_internet=true` supports Harbor 0.24 Docker startup. Python standard library, 2 CPU, 2 GiB, no GPU.
- Contamination: OR-set/LWW terminology is general; precise causal, sync and frontier contract plus randomized event graphs are project-original. No external or private evaluation data copied.
adaptation: All contracts, examples, and solvers for this revision are project-authored.
